text:
Rory Chen: Quick FYI — People Ops + Eng are kicking off a forward hiring surge to support Platform & Runtime growth. 12 reqs approved (mix of IC and senior IC), 4 immediate backfills, and a small program of 6 cross-team rotations to move existing talent where it's most needed. 

Rory Chen: TL;DR: reqs will be posted this week, interviews start in ~2 weeks, rotations and backfills begin Sept 1. Internal transfers prioritized. Hiring leads: Ana Martinez (Eng), Samir Patel (Recruiting).

Rory Chen: Action items: managers with tentative backfills — mark headcount in the HR sheet (https://r.infra/hire-q3) by EOD Thu; referrals -> referral form in thread; mentors needed for rotations (1 per rotation ideally).

Ana Martinez: Huge. Timeline OK. Are the rotations paid/switch processes standard or expedited?

Rory Chen: Rotations are standard lateral moves for 6 weeks with option to convert; expedited approvals for product-critical roles (we've pre-cleared 3).

Samir Patel: Recruiters will post and triage. High-level req IDs we'll post as they go (starting REQ-3891, REQ-3892). If you have a referral, DM me or use the form. We’ll prioritize internal candidates first.

Leah Park: Any changes to comp bands or leveling for these roles? curious about senior IC exceptions.

Rory Chen: No blanket band increases. Compensation exceptions possible via the comp committee — submit a case and cc Claire.

Claire Wu: Got it — I’ll review exceptions. Please include justification and market data.

Evan Carter: Platform will own onboarding for transferred folks. We can provide a two-week immersion plan and one mentor. Need headcount names by Aug 20.

Meera Singh: SRE can spare 1 mentor per rotation for runbook handoff and on-call triage training.

Recruiter Bot: New job post created REQ-3891 (Platform Engineer) by Samir Patel — https://recruiter.rw/REQ-3891

Samir Patel: Note — engineering managers: please flag any high-priority internal candidates in the spreadsheet (column "priority"). We will avoid double-schedules and try to cluster interviews to limit disruption.

Rory Chen: One more ask — owners of tickets or customer escalations that will be affected by these moves, annotate expected impact in the backlog ticket and ping me. Helps PMs and SRE prioritize coverage.

Leah Park: :thumbsup: I’ll annotate the top three runway tickets this afternoon.

Ana Martinez: Will there be a public deck or FAQ we can share with our teams?

Rory Chen: Yes — we’ll post a short FAQ and timeline doc in #people-ops and attach to the HR sheet by EOD tomorrow.

Samir Patel: For recruiting ops: interview calibration session Thurs 10am — please add at least one hiring-manager rep.

Meera Singh: Curious about rotation conversions — if a person converts early, how do we backfill their original role?

Rory Chen: If conversion happens before rotation end, we’ll fast-track a replacement hire or shift other rotations; we’ll handle case-by-case.

Claire Wu: Also logging this for approvals and audit — will need final list of moves and compensation changes by Sep 15.

Samir Patel: Reminder: internal candidates — priority window is 10 business days from posting. After that we'll open to external candidates.

Evan Carter: Thanks all. Platform team ready to provide onboarding schedule templates.

Rory Chen: Thanks team — big ask but should be a huge multiplier for product velocity. DM me for exceptions or questions. :party_parrot:
